status: exploratory follow-up after all primary finite-model results were observed
purpose: Verify an exact model reduction motivated by nuisance-query costs; do not replace primary comparisons
criterion: For each query, the support of (target plus remaining outcomes, query outcome) is a Cartesian product; retain integer multiplicities and separately check their product factorization
selection: query index order, repeated until no further query can be removed; leave at least one query
metrics: all twelve original catalogues, unchanged targets, same five policies, all raw cases, independent replay and compression checks
guarantee: support factorization preserves optimal worst query cost, not arbitrary policies or general expected-cost objectives
control: correlated metadata must remain if the product test fails
